name: Animal Mints
summary: **Animal Mints** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Seed Junky Genetics]] in Southern California. It is a cross of [[animal-cookies|Animal Cookies]] and [[sin-mint-cookies|Sin Mint Cookies]], two lines descended from [[gsc|GSC]]. Some sources describe it as a three-way cross that adds Blue Power directly.
